item.tib: dbal mo las kyi thig le'i rdzu 'phrul rlung 'khor gsang ba'i them yigs
item.coloph: de ltar rlung 'khor them yig 'di/ dbal gshen rngam tsha skyol pos mdzad/ hris pa gyer med gyi (kyis) nyams su blangs/ bla chen dran pas thugs dam mdzad/ mkhas pa mi bzhi'i (bzhis) gtan la phab/ mang mkhar lcags 'phrang la gter du sbas/ phyi bar (rabs) gter sgo phyed nas kyang / skal ldan rnams gyi (kyis) spyod par shog rlung 'khor gsang ba'i them yig rdzogs snyo/ rim gyis brgyud nas bdag la'o//
